source: FNCS 2026 EU Grand Finals, three matches saved from the Match Details pages
note: Coordinates are game units (1 unit = 1 cm). Times are seconds from match start. The storm schedule — every radius, every phase length, and from zone 5 the distance the centre moves — is identical in all three; only the direction it moves and where the first circle lands differ.
clocks: A team's timeAlive is counted from the moment it lands; the zone and elimination timestamps are counted from the start of the session. landingOffset is the gap, fitted per match by lining team death times up against the kill events: about fifty seconds of bus and freefall. Comparing the two without it makes every squad look fifty seconds shorter-lived than it was.
